Build prompt

Build “Pop-Up Shop Fitting Room Waitlist” on NeoApps for a pop-up retailer. Manage a first-in queue, call the next shopper and show a public board with anonymous ticket numbers. Limit records and exported data to the owning team. Include a demo with fictional records.

Acceptance test

Issue tickets 14 and 15. Calling next advances 14, while 15 remains waiting.
